imageloader: replace Init function with static factory method The static factory method prevents use between construction and initialization by only returning a value if initialization succeeds. This allows us to get rid of the initialized_ member and several CHECKs, since users will never see a value if it fails during LoadManifest. This is preferred style (see go/totw/42). This also makes IsValidFingerprintFile static since it doesn't depend on any members, which slightly simplifies a test. The CopyValidImage test is left untouched because it is marked a friend and has access to the private constructor and because its use case is somewhat more complicated.
